notes:
Tasks work properly on the phone now. Open one and you get the whole record: what it has to be handed in with, the checklist, a clock you can start and stop, the remarks, and everything that has happened to it. You can photograph evidence, hand it in with your location or your signature, ask for more time, and — when work has been handed back to you — approve it or send it back with a reason. Until now the app could only flip a status, so any task that asked for a photo or a location was refused with a message telling you to go and find a computer, which is not much help on a site.

The menu and the Admin Console now carry a red count on anything that is waiting on you — leave, attendance corrections, expenses, vouchers, the employee cashbook, payslip requests, complaints, courses, confirmations and the rest — so you can see what needs you without opening nine screens to find out.

Two smaller things. Who approves whose leave, and whose attendance corrections, is now set in one place under Permissions rather than hidden on the two screens it routes. And asking for a payslip now asks what you need it for, so HR can work through the queue in the order the reasons call for.
